top_events.title: Russian ships hit by Ukrainian drones off Libya coast, Zelensky says
top_events.label: Ukraine sinks Russian warship near Libya
top_events.summary: Ukrainian forces struck Russian naval vessels near Libya, sinking the warship Merkury. President Zelenskyy called the operation exemplary, marking a major expansion of Ukraine's operational reach.

top_events.title: Russia-bound ship towed away after it was attacked in Gulf of Finland
top_events.label: Ukrainian drone strikes Russian ship Gulf Finland
top_events.summary: A Russian vessel was attacked in the Gulf of Finland, likely by Ukrainian drones. The strike extends Ukraine's operational reach into the Baltic Sea region.

top_events.title: Boy, 7, pulled alive from rubble hours after Russian strike on Ukraine, rescuers say
top_events.label: Russian strike kills eleven in Dymer Ukraine
top_events.summary: Russian forces struck a residential building in Dymer, killing eleven people. A seven-year-old boy was pulled alive from the rubble hours after the attack.
